rules.Death Knight|Blood Tank: Ignore the socket bonus and gem pure +30 Stamina, except to activate Austere Earthsiege Diamond (it needs 2 blue gems and 1 red; you can use 1 Nightmare Tear 49110 or 1 Regal/Guardian's Dreadstone on a piece with a +9 or +12 Stamina bonus).
rules.Death Knight|Frost DPS: Respect yellow socket bonuses if they give +4 Strength or more, using Inscribed/Etched Ametrine; ignore blue sockets after activating the meta gem (with 1 Nightmare Tear + 1 Sovereign Dreadstone on the pieces with the highest Strength bonus).
rules.Death Knight|Unholy DPS: Respect yellow socket bonuses if they give +4 Strength or more, using Fierce/Inscribed Ametrine; in blue sockets only activate Chaotic Skyflare Diamond (1 Nightmare Tear + 1 Sovereign Dreadstone on pieces with a +6/+8 Strength bonus) and ignore the rest with +20 Strength.
rules.Druid|Balance: Respect socket bonuses if they give +5 Spell Power (for 1 non-red gem) or +7/+9 Spell Power (for 2 non-red gems); ignore any lower bonus and gem +23 Spell Power once the 2 blue gems for the meta are in place.
rules.Druid|Feral DPS: Use 1 Nightmare Tear in the blue socket with the highest bonus (+6 or +8 Agility) to activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond. Ignore the other blue sockets. Respect yellow sockets if the bonus is at least +4 Agility.
rules.Druid|Feral Tank: In ICC 25 Heroic, prioritize +30 Stamina (Solid Majestic Zircon) in almost every socket, using 1 Shifting Dreadstone (or Nightmare Tear) to meet the 1 red gem requirement of Austere Earthsiege Diamond on the piece with the best socket bonus.
rules.Druid|Restoration: Once the meta gem is active and the Haste breakpoint is reached (735 with Celestial Focus or 856 without it), gem +23 Spell Power (Runed Cardinal Ruby) in every socket except where the socket bonus gives at least +7 Spell Power.
rules.Hunter|Beast Mastery: Activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with 1 Nightmare Tear in the blue socket with the highest bonus (+6/+8 Agility). Respect yellow sockets with Deadly/Glinting Ametrine if the bonus is >= +4 Agility; ignore the other blue sockets.
rules.Hunter|Marksmanship: Use only 1 Nightmare Tear to activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond on the piece with the best bonus (+8/+6 Agility). Prioritize reaching exactly 1400 Armor Penetration with Fractured Cardinal Ruby, then use Delicate Cardinal Ruby (+20 Agility) or Deadly Ametrine in yellow sockets with a bonus >= +4 Agility.
rules.Hunter|Survival: Activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with 1 Nightmare Tear on the piece with the best bonus (+6/+8 Agility). Respect yellow sockets with Deadly/Glinting Ametrine if the bonus is >= +4 Agility; ignore all other blue sockets, gemming +20 Agility.
rules.Mage|Arcane: Respect yellow sockets with Reckless Ametrine if the bonus is >= +5 Spell Power. In blue sockets, use 2 Purified Dreadstone on the pieces with the best bonus (+7/+9 Spell Power) to activate Chaotic Skyflare Diamond and ignore the rest if they give less than +7 Spell Power.
rules.Mage|Fire: Thanks to glyphed Molten Armor (which converts 55% of Spirit into Critical Strike Rating with the T9 2-piece bonus, or 35% with T10), Purified Dreadstone is very competitive: respect socket bonuses whenever they give +5 Spell Power for 1 non-red gem or +7/+9 Spell Power for 2 non-red gems.
rules.Mage|Frost: Respect yellow sockets with Reckless Ametrine if the bonus is >= +5 Spell Power; use only 2 Purified Dreadstone on the pieces with the highest bonus to activate Chaotic Skyflare Diamond.
rules.Paladin|Holy: Ignore ALL socket bonuses and gem +20 Intellect (Brilliant King's Amber, or +34 Intellect Brilliant Dragon's Eye if you are a Jewelcrafter) in every red, yellow and blue socket, except for 1 Nightmare Tear (ID: 49110) in the blue socket with the best bonus, to meet both the 1 red and 1 blue gem requirements of Insightful Earthsiege Diamond at once.
rules.Paladin|Protection: Gem +30 Stamina (Solid Majestic Zircon) in every socket, using 1 purple gem (Regal/Guardian's Dreadstone) or 1 Nightmare Tear on a piece with a +9 or +12 Stamina bonus to meet the 1 red gem requirement of Austere Earthsiege Diamond.
rules.Paladin|Retribution: Use Relentless Earthsiege Diamond instead of Chaotic Skyflare because it only needs 1 blue gem (covered with 1 Nightmare Tear on the piece with the best +6/+8 Strength bonus). Respect yellow sockets with Inscribed/Etched Ametrine if the bonus is >= +4 Strength; ignore the other blue sockets with +20 Strength.
rules.Priest|Discipline: Prioritize +23 Spell Power (Runed Cardinal Ruby) in almost every socket to maximize Power Word: Shield absorption. Respect socket bonuses only if they give +7 or +9 Spell Power (or use the minimum hybrid gems needed to activate the meta gem).
rules.Priest|Holy: Thanks to the Spiritual Guidance talent (25% of Spirit converted to Spell Power), Purified Dreadstone (+12 SP / +10 Spirit) gives nearly as much Spell Power as a pure red gem plus regeneration; so respect socket bonuses whenever they give +5 Spell Power or more.
rules.Priest|Shadow: Respect yellow socket bonuses of +5 Spell Power or more using Reckless Ametrine. In blue sockets, use 2 Purified Dreadstone to activate Chaotic Skyflare Diamond and only respect additional blue sockets if the bonus is +7 or +9 Spell Power.
rules.Rogue|Assassination: Use Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with just 1 Nightmare Tear on the piece with the best bonus (+6/+8 Agility). Respect yellow sockets with Stark/Pristine Ametrine if the bonus is >= +4 Agility; ignore all other blue sockets, gemming +40 Attack Power.
rules.Rogue|Combat: Activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with 1 Nightmare Tear in the blue socket with the highest bonus (+6/+8 Agility). Prioritize reaching the 1400 Armor Penetration hard cap with Fractured Cardinal Ruby; in the leftover yellow sockets, respect bonuses of >= +4 Agility using Deft/Stark/Glinting Ametrine.
rules.Rogue|Subtlety: Activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with 1 Nightmare Tear on the piece with the best bonus (+6/+8 Agility). Respect yellow sockets with a bonus >= +4 Agility and ignore the other blue sockets.
rules.Shaman|Elemental: Respect yellow sockets with Reckless Ametrine if the bonus is >= +5 Spell Power. In blue sockets, use only the 2 purple gems needed (Glowing or Royal Dreadstone) on the pieces with the highest bonus (+7/+9 Spell Power) to activate Chaotic Skyflare Diamond and ignore the rest with +23 Spell Power.
rules.Shaman|Enhancement: In Phase 4 (ICC), Haste scales above Attack Power once the Spell Hit (368/342) and Expertise (140) caps are covered. Activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with 1 Nightmare Tear, use Stark Ametrine in red sockets with a good bonus (+6/+8 Agility or +16 AP) and Quick King's Amber (+20 Haste) in the remaining yellow and blue sockets.
rules.Shaman|Restoration: Prioritize reaching the 1265 Haste Rating soft cap by gemming Quick King's Amber (+20 Haste, or +34 Haste Quick Dragon's Eye if you are a Jewelcrafter) in almost every socket, using 1 Nightmare Tear (or 1 Reckless Ametrine + 1 Energized Eye of Zul) to activate Insightful Earthsiege Diamond.
rules.Warlock|Affliction: With Fel Armor (30%) and Glyph of Life Tap (20%), 10 Spirit gives +5 base Spell Power (+5.5 with Blessing of Kings), so Purified Dreadstone is worth about 17.5 Spell Power. Respect any socket bonus that gives +5 Spell Power for 1 non-red gem or +7/+9 Spell Power for 2 non-red gems.
rules.Warlock|Demonology: Respect socket bonuses of +5 Spell Power or more using Purified Dreadstone in blue and Reckless/Veiled Ametrine in yellow; if the bonus is only +5 SP but requires 2 non-red gems (one of them yellow), you can gem pure +23 Spell Power to maximize your contribution to Demonic Pact.
rules.Warlock|Destruction: Respect socket bonuses that give +5 Spell Power for 1 non-red gem or +7/+9 Spell Power for 2 non-red gems using Reckless/Potent Ametrine and Purified Dreadstone; ignore the rest with +23 Spell Power.
rules.Warrior|Arms: Activate Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with 1 Nightmare Tear in the blue socket with the highest bonus (+6/+8 Strength). Prioritize reaching 1260 Armor Penetration Rating (90% + 10% Battle Stance = 100%), then gem Bold Cardinal Ruby (+20 Strength) and Inscribed Ametrine in yellow sockets with a bonus >= +4 Strength.
rules.Warrior|Fury: Use Relentless Earthsiege Diamond with just 1 Nightmare Tear on the piece with the highest bonus (+6/+8 Strength). Ignore the other blue sockets. Reach the 1400 Armor Penetration Rating hard cap with Fractured Cardinal Ruby, then use Bold Cardinal Ruby (+20 Strength) and Inscribed Ametrine in yellow sockets with a bonus >= +4 Strength.
rules.Warrior|Protection: Gem +30 Stamina (Solid Majestic Zircon) in every socket except 1 Shifting/Guardian's Dreadstone (or 1 Nightmare Tear) on a piece with a +9 or +12 Stamina bonus to meet the 1 red gem requirement of Austere Earthsiege Diamond.
